title: Stochastic Parrots or Singing in Harmony? Testing Five Leading LLMs for their Ability to Replicate a Human Survey with Synthetic Data

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distribution of synthetic LLM survey responses regarding political ideologies, partisan polarization, and the democratic impact of technology against actual human survey data of Silicon Valley tech workers.
Evaluating whether LLMs over-predict ethical behavior and the refusal to comply with unethical workplace directives compared to counter-intuitive ground-truth human compliance rates.

Testing if LLM outputs rely on mainstream conventional wisdoms, generalized narratives, and stereotypes about the values and beliefs of Silicon Valley developers rather than accurately reflecting the nuanced lived experiences of the cohort.
